title.narrative: Translation and editing of how-to notes

description.narrative: In 2020 Denmark adopted a new development strategy “The World We Share”. In relation hereto, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has prepared a number of how-to notes. The notes will give concrete direction to ensure the implementation of “The World We Share”, the government’s development policy priorities 2021-2025 and the 4-year-plans. The objective of the task is to translate the Danish notes into English and to make a linguistic edit of both the Danish and English versions. There are 11 notes in total, averaging at about 7000 words each. The Danish notes have already gone through several rounds of editing within the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, so only a light linguistic editing of the Danish notes is expected. The work involves looking across the notes to ensure consistency in language, use of abbreviations and formatting. The consultant must deliver 22 edited how-to notes (11 Danish notes and 11 English notes).
